name: v1.0 - Initial Release
body:
## One-Person Company v1.0

First public release of the multi-agent collaboration harness.

### Core Modules

- **Red-Blue Debate (红蓝对抗)** — Attack the spec before any code exists. Red team finds edge cases, Blue team builds solutions, Analyst verifies facts, Debate Judge converges disputes. 3-round max.
- **Test-Driven Development** — Integration + e2e tests are mandatory deliverables. Code QA + Function QA + audit script form an unskippable acceptance chain. Dev coordinator demoted from judge to dispatcher.
- **Retrospective & Constitution (复盘宪法)** — After delivery, prosecution vs defense debate classifies every failure. Process violations auto-deposit into management constitution. 3 strikes = warning, 5 = severe.

### Key Features

- Complexity grading with "user-visible product" safety net
- Audit script (harness_auditor.py) blocks delivery if reports are missing
- Browser-side QA: link clicking, dark/light switch, 375px mobile resize
- MCP sandbox support for Codex on Windows
- Layered constitution injection per role
- 26 files, all under 43 lines — fits in AI attention span

### Stack

- Planning: Hermes (DeepSeek V4)
- Coding: Codex (GPT-5.5)
- Protocol: MCP

### Install

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/
git clone https://github.com/zzzkeepdd/one-person-company.git
```

Then: "Hermes, 启动一人公司，我要开发一个 XX"
